articleTitle: Clustering Student Learners based on performance using K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Information Processing Speed is to how a learner can quickly process the incoming information. Many researchers consider Information Processing Speed as a central aspect of IQ. Many children with attention problems are unable to cope up with the lesson presented by the teacher. A student with such attention problems quickly give up trying if they can’t able to process the initial information quickly. Processing speed is one of four psychometric constructs that are considered important in helping us understanding an individual child’s learning abilities. Each individual has its own processing speed so that teaching should also be done according to the processing speed cognitive of an individual. In this work a new method is developed to determine the processing speed of each student and classifies them using K-means clustering algorithm into pre-defined number of clusters.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition using OpenCV and Python on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Face acknowledgment is a typical piece of a security framework, and its value is to recognize the face is human or not. Picture process is the foundation of any security framework like unique mark lock framework, face lock framework, eye recognition. Face discovery utilizing raspberry pi 4 is a quicker picture process and its legitimate ID of a face. The raspberry pi 4 is the most recent minimal expense Mastercard size PC. In this paper face location framework for security, intention depends on open-source PC vision (OpenCV) with python programming. By utilizing an alternate information base it’s not difficult to prepare the mentor and identifier. This idea is higher degree on security and robotization frameworks.

articleTitle: Benefits of Artificial Intelligence in the Legal System and Law Enforcement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In a populous nation, crime is inescapable. All claims are taken to court, ranging from trivial misdemeanors to notable felonies. Factoring out criminal law, there is civil and common law. Most cases of which are also presented in court. 3.5 crore cases are pending, of which 2.4 crore cases are solely criminal. This thoroughly exhausts our judicial system. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has long been used for data analysis and interpretation. The domain of AI has been utilized in numerous judiciaries and is now slowly creeping its way into Indian Law. The initiation of AI into legal studies has the potential to remodel and assist the judicial system. In addition to assisting the courts, AI can also aid law enforcement in solving cases and maintaining the community’s prosperity.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Personality Prediction on Twitter data using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: social networks are becoming more and more important so that everyone can share their content, activities, thoughts, opinions, emotions, feelings, etc. trends, to infer people’s behavior, etc. In the proposed work, it aims to analyze the personality of different people based on their tweets from the social media “twitter”. For this, it is proposed to use machine learning techniques such as regression models such as logistic regression on a group of tweets to predict personality. Existing jobs are available for personality prediction through the user profile. The proposed personality prediction is based on the content of a bunch of tweets and comes in the form of five different personality traits.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Early Detection and Timely Diagnosis of Mental Illness - A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Mental health includes the overall well-being of an individual. It affects the daily life style and relationships of an individual. Physical health has always found space in regular discussions, whereas mental health has always been side-lined. Mental health and physical health are equally important and interrelated components of overall health. It is essential to take care of mental health in the same way as physical health. The health industry has successfully found new ways to treat physical diagnoses. There are solutions to all sorts of physical problems. But, the diagnosis of mental health is still a point of research. The turn of the century has witnessed machine learning, data mining, and several other technologies in diagnosing physical health problems like cancer, Arrhythmia. Early identification of mental illness is major setback in providing timely diagnosis. In this paper we aim to explore the pre-existing work of several technologies in the field of psychiatric care. The goal behind writing this paper is to speed up the existing research on early identification of mental disorders and faster and timely treatment of the same.

articleTitle: IoT Based GPS tracking system with SOS Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This paper offers a concept for a battery-powered, GPS-based tracking system with continuous tracking and an SOS function that is based on IoT. The device when triggered uses a micro-controller and a GPS module to extract location data and send it to a group of registered users and a central server using a GSM module via SMS and AT commands. The central server will store the location periodically in a MongoDB and NodeJS based database. This data will be accessible to the user presented on a map using Open Layers via an HTML pages-based website hosted on AWS using registered credentials. The SMS received by registered guardians will also have the triggered location of the device formatted in a link that opens the location in google maps. During the SOS mode, all nearby devices whose location is stored in the database will also be alerted creating a community of secure users.

articleTitle: A compact and efficient triband antenna for Wi-Fi/WLAN/WiMAX/5G Mid-frequency band
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This research paper reports a compact patch antenna excited through a coplanar waveguide (CPW) transmission line. Slotting and stubbing techniques are employed for multi-band operation. The antenna covers 2.4 Wi-Fi, 2.45 and 5.8 WLAN, 3.5 WiMAX and 3.7 (5G Sub-6 GHz) mid-frequency bands. The presented antenna is built on a low-cost FR-4 substrate with a suitable size of 32$\times20\times$1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and it has good efficiency and steady gain over the operational spectrum. The experimentally measured results confirm the simulated results and demonstrate good agreement.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of a Necklace-Shape Slotted Microstrip Antenna for Future High-Band 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This study introduces and designs a slotted microstrip antenna which can be applied for high-band 5G applications. The antenna can be used for high bit rate, less traffic, and expands user retention.A classic rectangular microstrip antenna’s return loss, gain, and bandwidth is improved by superimposing a square and a circular slot. The proposed antenna is designed on an FR4 substrate with 0.8-millimeter thickness, having a dielectric constant of 4.3 and loss tangent of 0.025. A 50 Ω feeding line is applied to feed the antenna. The provided antenna’s return loss, gain, and bandwidth are -48.877 dB, 6.51 dBi, and 3.088 GHz, correspondingly.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mart System Using NLP For Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Shops and malls offer a wide variety of products. Products like clothes, beverages, books, and food can be considered products of domestic use. The purpose of supermarkets is to make shopping convenient for customers and to save their time, but sometimes the customer is dissatisfied while standing in line for the cash register and sometimes the customer is upset while weighing everything before they are billed. Shopping malls in large cities are packed with crowds during the weekends. Multiple sales and discounts further complicate the situation. Many items are purchased today and subsequently placed in the shopping basket. Billing process takes a lot of time for this process to be completed. The intelligent trolley is intended for a world where everyone has access to information and technology. By using IoT, the trolleys can be paired with main counters and package counters. Using the system, customers can easily locate the products by following the right path. The trolley is equipped with Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) screen and barcode scanner so users can scan the data on products. After the barcode is scanned, a display on the LCD screen accurately displays the product name and cost, and the counter updates accordingly. In addition to this feature, the customer will also be able to delete unwanted products and the check-out counter will be updated. With the swiping machine that is attached to the trolley, customers can pay using the Unified Payment Option (UPI) that is displayed on the monitor. By implementing the proposed system, the time a customer spends in line for billing is reduced. This system allows the customer to pay for their bill easily and to collect their items without delay in the Exit Pack. In addition, the system facilitates cash payments at separate counters without any delay for the customer. IBM cloud, an open platform for data manipulators, is used to retrieve, store and manipulate customer data through the cloud database. Using natural language processing (NLP), language conversion is possible.

articleTitle: AI Chatbot: Application in Psychiatric Treatment and Suicide Prevention
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In today’s fast-moving world, people irrespective of their field of work suffer from extensive mental stress be it students, working professionals, or the whole population in general due to various contributing factors, such as competition in the workplace, hectic work-hours, insomnia, strained relationships and many others such as unhealthy work environment. This issue is much more pronounced in the urban population. We aim to develop a chatbot that can imitate a psychologist as close as possible with the ability to detect suicidal tendencies and take the appropriate course of action.

articleTitle: Denoised Autoencoder using DCNN Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Many image denoising models have been designed for enhancing visibility of noisy images. In computer vision denoising of images is an important problem. A lot of emphasis is given to Machine Learning and Deep Learning approach in this regard. This work proposes the study of Deep Convolutional Neural network-based model VGG16 with the custom dataset of bad weather outdoor images via Transfer Learning. The sequential model 1 and model 2 is evaluated to have smooth image. The model architecture using Deep CNN is designed, and training of model is obtained using transfer learning. A model using autoencoder is designed. To decrease training time and perform better rectified Linear Unit (RELU) is used. Number of epochs identified to have increased performance in CNN. Further various optimizers are compared to have better accuracy. The estimation of performance such as RMSE and PSNR values are evaluated. The model is applied to single as well as 25 own outdoor images.

articleTitle: Automated Gate Control System using Face Mask Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This research paper gives a brief idea of controlling entrance gates of different areas like metro stations, railway stations, airports, corporate offices, restaurants, hotels and home with the face mask detection technology. In this, the camera will capture the real time video of a person using Artificial Intelligence[15],whosoever is entering the gate, processes the video and detects if the concerned person is wearing the mask properly or not. If the person is wearing a mask then the gate will open, if not then the gate will remain closed until the mask has been worn properly. The main motivation for this project comes from the current situation in the world where Covid-19 is spreading at a pace which is being difficult to control. This upcoming technology prototype can fuel in new ideas into different projects which are already ongoing to battle the pandemic. Also, the scope of this technology is not just limited to the face mask detection and has a wider and a more complex use-case in the real world.

articleTitle: A Review on Techniques and Applications of Object Tracking and Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Detecting different items in a picture with the aid of computers using any of the numerous detection techniques is referred to as object detection in computer vision. A thorough examination of several research papers on object identification, object tracking (its extension), and gesture recognition (an application) reveals the varied methodologies and algorithms employed in these tasks. The practice finds applications in several areas like the military, medical science, surveillance, autonomous vehicle science etc. We are at a point where we can comfortably compute these things locally on a smartphone. So far the literature in these areas is promising. Only hurdle is training the programs to perform as intended may need more power than the machine that runs the end product. A look at various works in the field gives a view of how the technology in the sector has progressed and what can be done with it. Various contemporary techniques are available which can be used with relative ease and can be tweaked without much hassle, for example - SSD, RCNN, YOLO.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control Scheme for Hybrid Energy Storage Technologies in a DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Intermittent nature of the renewable energy source i.e. photovoltaic leads to a demand of the battery energy storage system to sustain a continuous power supply for the load. However, the battery energy storage medium alone is not capable to meet the dynamic variation in the load demand. Therefore, there is a requirement for an additional energy storage medium i.e. supercapacitor (SC) that can handle the dynamic variation in the load demand. Further, the hybrid energy storage system (HESS) i.e. combination of battery and SC can provide the average and dynamic variation in the load demand, respectively. In this study, a sliding mode control (SMC) scheme is applied for controlling HESS in a photovoltaic-based microgrid. The SMC control strategy provides better power-sharing among the photovoltaic energy source, HESS and load. The simulation of microgrid is done using the MATLAB/Simulink tool. The simulation results with varying irradiance, and varying load demand verify this control strategy by maintaining the voltage of DC link constant at its nominal value.

articleTitle: Man-In-The-Middle-Attack and Proposed Algorithm for Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Today, when every-day processes are going online, the risk of cyber-attacks are increasing at an exponential rate. As everything is going online, we see an increase in the availability of public Wi-Fi as a marketing strategy to attract customer’s. A common attack in public Wi-Fi(s) is ManInTheMiddleAttack. We have implemented ManInTheMiddleAttack by the method of ARP-Spoofing and we have detected it with a common algorithm, and we have proposed an entirely new algorithm which can be used in the future to detect and prevent ManInTheMiddleAttacks.

articleTitle: Virtual machine for IOS devices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The purpose of this research paper is to focus on virtual machines to run android on iOS devices without jailbreak. To run virtual machines on iOS devices requires kernel and CPU support that is not available now. So, this paper addresses this problem. Relative studies show that iOS has an entitlement that is listed in the guidelines of the app store, but this research paper disagrees with the factors like lack of CPU and kernel support because of third party applications available in addition to that iOS provides SDK, developer resources, headers.

articleTitle: Efficient IoT based Smart Home Assistance System with Electrical Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Automation is defined as a technology which is proceeds by accepting the commands from a programmed code embedded with feedback control working automatically. Thus, this type of system ensures to show possibilities of completing a work with less human interaction. Among this automation home automation is one of the leading technologies which leads to a future where a normal household could have control and monitoring capabilities over each and every appliance just from any corner of the house. The use of “Internet of Things” had and still going to play a major role in managing the automation system. There are different types of IoT Wireless communication system’s where the data is exchanged between the client and the devices among them Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GSM play a vital role in allowing the client to exchange the data. In spite of all these, home automation has always been an extension rather than being an integration for an existing system. In order to overcome such problem, we are going to implement this work “Electrical Control Unit”. This system mainly focuses on the scalability over already existing system using ESP32s and allowing the user to make their existing system smarter and also allows the user to make a routine or scheduled tasks via smart assistants (Alexa, Google), other than controlling the appliances over Manual Switches. This work also has Wireless communication capability over WIFI where it could communicate with over devices or assistants or over web Application.

articleTitle: Real Time Smart Water Management System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This paper describes an Internet of Things device that helps with water usage management and planning for RO filters at home. In residential complexes, this strategy is straight forward to implement. Sensors provide real-time information on the water quality. This information will be saved in the cloud. In order to provide safe and secure water, real-time water quality must be monitored. A sensor network is included in the present system, which is used to assess temperature, TDS, and water flow. Data measured from the sensors are analyzed using Arduino UNO controller. Finally, the sensor values can be examined using the Wi-Fi module. This study employs IoT to give a cost-effective approach for real-time quality monitoring (IoT). A large network that assists IoT devices and applications is called an IoT cloud. This comprises the infrastructure, servers, and storage required for real-time processing and operations. Data can be submitted to the cloud from user’s device to visualize live data in real time.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Risk Zonation Mapping using Fuzzy Overlay Analysis of Nainital District
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Fire is a global phenomenon that has wreaked havoc on wildlife and human property in recent years. Forest fires have been a recurrent and historic occurrence in Uttrakhand. Every year, forest fires in Uttrakhand devastate the ecosystem, flora and wildlife, and economic prosperity of the state. It is one of the most serious natural disasters to strike Uttrakhand’s forests. Forest fires in Uttrakhand were caused by a combination of high temperatures and a lack of air moisture. Forest fires have been detected using remote sensing and GIS technology and new technologies can give an early warning to avert forest fires. Remote sensing has also been employed successfully in research monitoring, forest fire detection, and prediction modeling. As a result, the major goal of this research is to combine many factors that cause forest fires and establish risk zones to avoid and mitigate fire-related losses. The research area is the Nainital region, which is located at 29.3919N and 79.4542E and covers 11.73km2. Fire can also result in the loss of life and property, as well as poor air quality and water contamination. As a result, forest fires must be assessed and mitigated in various sections of the country.

articleTitle: Enhancement in the Reliability of Vehicular Communication System for Road Side Area
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) is developed to provide vehicular communication with reliable and cost-efficient data distribution. With the timely addition of VANET developments, a system framework is established, currently known as Vehicular Communication System (VCS). The Vehicular Communication System is a cooperative engagement of Vehicle Nodes with efficient utilization of OnBoard Unit (OBU), Cluster Head (CH), Road Side Unit (RSU) and Infrastructure Domain Unit (IDU). This system is applicable for event prediction and reduction of many things like fuel utilization, traveling time, road area congestion, accident, etc. In this work, firstly the reliability and scalability of the Vehicular Communication System are analyzed for the clustering formation by various vehicular communication technologies. In this analysis, it is found that reliability and scalability are higher of Optical Wireless Communication (OWC), Satellite communication, Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access, Long-range and 4G-5G technologies. During analyzing reliability and scalability for VCS, it is also found that the 802. 11p standard can increase the transmission power by tempering Contention Window Size when congestion is increased in the control channel. The efficiency and reliability of the VCS can be enhanced if the transmission power is increased when data is transferred from a single node of the CH. Increasing the transmitting power of the CH source node increases the interference power in the broadcasting of the receiver also. Here comes the need in CH to understand how to adjust transmitting power between multiple nodes and rate the channel access with a single node to control channel congestion. For this here two previously available metrics BRM and BEM are upgraded. Based on this, there is an enhancement in reliability with increasing efficiency. This performance enhancement is evaluated using Network Simulator.

articleTitle: Thermal effect on Layers of 3D Printed Components & its impact on Material’s Property
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the thermal interaction of layers of 3D printed components. Thermal bond formation happens as a result of the raw material’s molten condition and ultimately determines the overall integrity and mechanical properties of the resulting prototypes. The quality of strong layers and their bindings was determined by computing and evaluating fluctuations in their strength and heat dissipation rate at the borders between the connected layers. Temperature profiles for 3D printed components created under various processing settings were analysed, as well as the impacts on the structure and thermal attributes. Parallel to the investigation, predictions of the degree of bonding accomplished during the 3D printing process were established using thermal analysis of layer thermal conductivity (ABS polymer). The current research is based on a study of the heat and strength analysis of a 3D printed layer under a variety of various conditions, including changes in surrounding temperature, cooling time, humidity, airflow rate, and form and orientation of an item. The project will begin with the creation of three-dimensional models using simulation software. The qualities such as hardness, the speed at which molten material cools layer by layer, and bonding forces, among others while creating the 3D printed model were evaluated. These qualities were verified at several points throughout the 3D printing process.

articleTitle: Predicting crop yield with NDVI and Backscatter values using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Agriculture is India’s major cause of income and even plays a critical part in ensuring food security in the Indian economy. India’s agricultural sector faces the tough problem of maximizing crop productivity. A common problem for Indian farmers is not selecting the right crops based on their soil needs. This has an impact on productivity. Predicting yield before harvest helps farmers take appropriate trading and repository measures. This work assists agronomists to realize the yield of crops before planting them on their farmland. Consequently, it guides farmers in taking the right decisions. Deep learning (DL) can be an important consideration in obtaining an effective solution for yield forecasting. This study is primarily based on providing accurate yield prediction with a focus on key crops. The deep Neural Network (DNN) model is employed for predicting the crop yield. The proposed deep learning model takes the inputs such as crop, season, Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), backscatter values, and area, which are then analyzed in the hidden layers using weights that are adjusted throughout training. Yield prediction of a crop in kilogram (kg) is then spewed out by the model. The findings obtained with this method show higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Load Balancing Algorithm through MetaHuristics Approaches for Cloud-Computing-Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This research work is related to load balancing for implementing the performance of resource utilization. The issues for maximum load balancing requirement in cloud computing. And are using more resources to balance the load in research solutions. So that reduces the parameters such as response time, request time, and makespan. So this work focuses on load balancing because when do we compare with the other parameters in load balancing and cloud services provided by models such as services model and deployment models such as IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS and deployment model public, private, and community in cloud computing. And hybrid is a combination of two models like public and private. This paper is about of goal of load balancing coming from multiple users. Perfectly balancing in a cloud or datacenter. Because it will be necessary to develop an effective load balancing strategy to appropriately allocate Virtual Machine to physical resources. The simulated result will be using the cloudsim tool to succeed in load balancing balanced based on random optimizations.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition Using Machine Learning for Light Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Gesture recognition has a wide range of human-computer interface (HCI) applications in the home, commerce or office. However, the most widely used methods for recognizing gestures are computationally expensive and costly. We propose to apply gesture recognition to an existing visible light communication (VLC) system. Different finger motions are detected using a long short-term memory (LSTM) network operating on light transitions between fingers. At the receiver side, the platform utilizes a light-emitting diode and photodiode. The device can distinguish motions from gaps in direct light transmission, making it compatible with high-speed light communication systems. The accuracy of gesture identification was evaluated for five different gestures over a distance of 48 cm and the findings show the method is capable of successfully identifying the motions with 88 percent accuracy.

articleTitle: Pricing on Use of Cloud Computing and Internet of Things for Optimized Agricultural Practices
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This paper endeavours to provide a better future for the agro industry in middle-and low-income countries such as India. The project incorporates various technical domains such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and Cloud - Computing to optimise agricultural practices. The focus here is directed primarily towards farms located in the much-isolated areas far from the reaches of contemporary technology. Only 186 million people utilise the internet in rural India, which has a population of 918 million people according to the 2011 census. As more and more farms and cottage industries are centred in and around rural zones, connectivity and access to the web is virtually absent. The situation above doesn’t bode well for farmers and cultivators who hope to obtain the very best out of every yield. The system thus proposed uses a combination of Wireless Sensor Networks, GSM modules (or even fixed landline connections) along with the cloud to effectively retrieve accurate real time data from the fields and transmit it through a medium such as a desktop / mainframe to the cloud where it is stored and analysed using tested algorithms that then provide an optimal guide to the farmer located at the field.

articleTitle: Arduino based Economical Floor Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Robotics technology breakthroughs have made life much easier and more comfortable for humans. Over the past few years, the robots have entered most of the fields including the household. Robotic floor cleaners are designed to be easier to clean than handheld vacuums. The main goal of this article is to develop and implement a low-cost prototype of a floor cleaning robot. The manual cleaning process can be replaced by automated cleaning robots. So over there is a require for cleaning robots.

articleTitle: Detection of Black Hole Attack on Max LEACH Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Wireless networks are one of the branches of telecommunication science in the present age, the effects of which are clearly seen in daily life. In a special type of these networks, a set of sensors are connected to each other to collect information in a wireless environment and are known as wireless sensor networks. Because security and privacy are so important in many of the proposed applications for wireless sensor networks, this type of networks are usually set up to collect records from an unsafe environment. Almost all WSN security protocols emphasize that an attacker can generally control a sensor node by direct physical access. The advent of sensor networks as one of the major technologies in the future has poses various challenges for researchers. Black hole attack is very common because it drops the packets and invades communication process. There are different strategies to detect black hole attack in network, like measurement of residual energy or packet delivery ratio and also because it identifies themselves as cluster head (CH) another strategy can be based on how many times node is chosen as CH. In this paper first consider 10 nodes as black hole node and then based on residual energy, detected black hole attack on Max LEACH protocol.

Author Keywords: Security Issues in Wireless Sensor Network

articleTitle: Automatic Co-Registration of Aerial and Satellite Imagery using optimized minimum distance thresholds for matching
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Imagery is captured by different satellites, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV’s), equipment’s or sensors, from different angles and at different time frames. Difference in nature of data, orientations or settings of satellites, equipment’s or sensors may lead to introduction of errors in the imagery. Due to various such errors it becomes difficult for the imagery to be deployed in various remote sensing applications such as fusion of images, change detection panorama creation etc. Hence, we need image registration which geometrically aligns images belonging to the same area. This paper provides a solution for removal of the registration errors automatically for multi temporal and multi resolution imagery, hence facilitating Automatic Image co-registration. Feature extraction utilizes the SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features). Feature matching is done using Fast Library for Approximate Nearest Neighbours (FLANN) matcher. The work focuses on solving the problems faced in matching of valid key point descriptors of the sensed and reference imagery, particularly the panchromatic satellite imagery. Multiple scenarios for minimum distance thresholds have been visualized for eliminating the bad matches. Very high accuracy of less than a meter in most cases has been achieved for satellite imagery, using the above method of image registration.

articleTitle: Analysis on Content Based Image Retrieval - A logical survey
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In present time, the introduction of free internet and database has made use data on the real time application and web media. The prominence of visual proficiency in human visual attention was remarkable. This paper is proposed to identify the prominent effect of visual saliency in Content based image retrieval (CBIR) through to other quality experiments. Over a period, the major images have been kept in in huge data bases. Any single method not been utilised to help in retrieval of any images from the database and it became a tough task. In this paper a technique is used to make process simpler, in which the provided query image in input is utilised To retrieve image of set of images having parallel attributes. The major aim of the image retrieving technique is to get at most clarity to the input query image on the basis of standard features. In the area of image processing, the state of the art technologies has been discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Surface Roughness Driven Broadband Second Harmonic Generation in Zinc Selenide slab
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The effect of surface roughness on second harmonic broadband generation in the region of mid-infrared, in a reverse tapered semiconductor slab made up of Zinc Selenide (ZnSe) is described analytically in this paper using total internal reflection-quasi phase matching (TIR-QPM) technique. After taking into account for roughness and scattering due to reflection, a computer-aided simulation of ZnSe slab yielded a 3-dB bandwidth of 343.04 nm centering at 7.33 μm with a peak conversion efficiency of 1.19%. The effect of variation in crystal length, operating temperature, and tapered angle on the performance parameter has been evaluated.

articleTitle: Role of IOT in Supply Chain Innovation: A Survey Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The main goal of this work is to elucidate the role of IoT in supply chain management (SCM) and how it has helped improve the overall SCM process. Frequency identification (RFID) is being recognized as one of the emerging SCM technologies. SCM’s Internet of Things helps track objects and is used to remotely control the weather in transportation processes. This white paper also highlights the role of RFID-IoT in SCM such as monitoring, identification, logistics tracking and product quality assurance. This task defines IoT implementations at various stages of SCM, such as production tracking, shipping and distribution, retail tracking, and inventory tracking. I tried to learn their opinions on how to distribute the questionnaire among 50 businessmen and manage the supply chain effectively.

articleTitle: Optimal capacitor placement under distribution system using open-source toolbox
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In the paper, optimal capacitor placement based problem has been solved under a distribution system-using an open-source Python tool i.e., Pandapower. Pandapower is a power system analysis tool used for various load flow analyses and system optimization in the power system. Pandapower is easy to use and appropriate for simulation and optimization for power system-based problems. In the paper, a distribution system, connected to main grid is considered for the placement of capacitor to minimize the active power losses, which will result in the reduction of power flow and stress on the feeder line. This technique effectively increased the life span of the network. It also provides benefits to the existing system to deals with the future load demand. To implement the proposed approach, the IEEE 33 bus data for the distribution system is utilized.

articleTitle: MS 8T1M nvSRAM Cell with Improved Write Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In this paper, a memristor baser read decoupled (RD) 8T1M non-volatile SRAM (nvSRAM) cell is presented. The proposed cell supports single ended read for solving read write conflict and single ended write operations to save power; and uses multiple sharing (MS) scheme to improve write margin. It uses transmission gate (TG) as access transistor to further improve write-delay and write-margin. The write power consumption of proposed cell is found to be reduced by 96.84% in comparison to existing RD 8TlR cell whereas an increase of 29.78% is observed in reference to MS 7TlR cell. The proposed cell shows remarkable improvement of 47.18% and 19.38% in write delay and write margin in comparison to existing RD nvSRAM cells. The store/restore performance of the cell remains same as existing RD counterparts.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Optimization Technique Based PID Controller for Isolated Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In present network of electricity, micro grid’s are mostly used in power system due to their technical, economic and environmental advantages.Because of the variable nature of loads and the irregular behavior of inexhaustible energy resources, the frequency variations occur in micro grid particularly in the isolated way of working. In this paper, for controlling the frequency of the load in isolated micro grids which consists of many resources of energy, Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) algorithm is used. By the utilization of given evolutionary algorithm the variables of suggested GWO based PID Controller has improved. To control the frequency of the load of microgrid the GWO tuned PID controller presents a superb execution. The model is done in MATLAB and the output results are corelated with other optimization methods based PID controller. The end outcome which are obtained show the supremacy of the suggested method in reducing the frequency variations.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Product Design and Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Manufacturing companies must adapt and innovate in order to stay competitive. With this latest breakthrough, sustainable manufacturing will be made possible utilizing new technology. To encourage sustainable practices, it is essential that production practices be accompanied with wise use of production technologies. Due to this, AI-based methods, such as machine learning, have already been used in the industry for product design and production processes. The main goal of the study in this invited paper was to examine the literature on how artificial intelligence and machine learning (ML) are used in industry. Artificial intelligence and machine learning are now regarded as the key components in the smart industrial revolution. The significance of artificial intelligence and its usefulness in context to product design and manufacturing has been discussed carefully in this paper looking in to the satisfaction of future customer needs, and how to create a healthy and harmonious lifestyle also.

articleTitle: Fog Assisted Industrial IoT Module for Cycle Time Capturing in Apparel Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This paper introduces a solution for cycle time capturing in the apparel industry. Currently, the entire cycle time counting operation is manually carried out, leading to inefficiencies in strengthening the operational level observations and the inability to identify the non-value addition activities of the operations. The cycle time capturing module is designed to capture events from operation lines to visualize real-time dashboards. Dashboards are displayed in front of each factory line to give performance alerts to machine operators when necessary. In addition, gathered data is integrated into the cloud platform, which will provide data analytics. The module’s four main components include the mobile application, which captures cycle time from the user-end, business administration application designed to get the business and planned information to the system, dashboard and the fog node. The proposed system potentially improves the real-time decision-making process by providing real-time alerts and real-time analytics. Furthermore, it promotes the production level efficiency and effectiveness by supporting critical key performance indicators (KPI) to drive continuous improvements in production.

articleTitle: Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition with Self-co-articulation removal in Indoor and Outdoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In a continuous video sequence, recognition of dynamic hand gestures is a challenging task and more difficulties arise when the recording environment is also dynamic in nature. This paper proposes a system which solves the problem of the complex environment. It also tries to solve the problem of presence of unwanted strokes during the formation of the gesticulation pattern. Gestures used in this paper are recorded in both indoor and outdoor environment. Detection is done by a two-level algorithm using skin color and motion information. Hand tracking is done using modified tracker which overcomes the difficulties arising in existing KLT due to movement of hand. Incremental feature selection is utilized to use only those features for recognition which provides best results in terms of accuracy. SVM is utilized for recognition of the gestures and the recognition accuracy has been compared with deep learning algorithm also. It has been observed that 96.67% recognition accuracy is being achieved using deep learning which is better than existing machine learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Solutions of the Bulk Transportation Problem with Two Criteria and Two Modes of Transportation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: A novel algorithm is developed to find optimal solutions of a bulk transportation problem with two criteria and two modes of transportation. The two criteria are total cost of transportation and total duration of transportation with cost being given the first priority. The set of Optimal solutions obtained gives more flexibility to the decision maker. Comparison with existing works show that the novel algorithm gives better solutions with respect to minimizing the duration of transportation, very useful in case of transporting perishable goods or during emergency situations such as war. The algorithm can also be applied to bi-criteria bulk transportation problems with 3 or more modes of transport.

articleTitle: Review: Drone applications in Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The transmission line tower is the required part in the electricity transmission system. The maintenance system of the transmission line is also to be considered for the proper considerations. The unmanned aerial vehicles also called as drones are used for the purpose of the maintenance of the transmission line system. The technical problem associated with the drone system is also considered to be for the solution of the problems associated with it. This trend is new for the problem solving techniques. Existing techniques of the inspection have many problems involved in the inspection and therefore the new innovative techniques are needed. The present work is related to the review work which is carried out on the transmission line system with the drone system so that the different techniques involved in this are mentioned and presented.

articleTitle: Survey on Data Leakage Prevention through Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: As the Internet develops and network data transmission keeps on expanding, managers are confronted with the errand of holding private data back from leaving their organizations. In different information leakage cases, information misfortune is caused mostly by human missteps. Currently government associations show that the quantities of information leakage occasions have developed rapidly. One of the significant issues in the data security research is information spillage or information misfortune particularly brought about by insider danger as insider dangers can possibly deliver serious harm to the association’s assets, monetary resources and notoriety. Therefore protection and suspection of data detection can restrict the associations from willing to share the information from one another and this is one of the significant errands in the data security. In this paper, we study various literatures showing mitigation of data leakage. There is a need to develop and design a framework or sensitive data detection model for data leakage prevention.

articleTitle: Survey of Security Issues in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Cloud computing’s exponential development is drastically affecting how people use current network services. Cloud-based service offerings and enabling flexible adoptions of on-demand requirements have a variety of applications. While there are several advantages of using plenty of valuable cloud technology services, it also has a range of security risks and challenges. Security issues are challenges for the researchers that need to be adequately addressed to prevent security breaches and attacks that are threats for service providers and service users. This paper comprises some generally accepted security threats and potential countermeasures for cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: A Model for Secure Food through smart technologies - IOT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Food, is very essential in our Life. because without food humans can’t survive. During the time of COVID-19 pandemic, it is extremely crucial to take precautions about the food we consume. During this pandemic, people around the world have become more and more cautious about food security. Keeping this in mind food safety and quality is one of the vital matters we observe throughout our lives. Internet of Things (IOT) is a domain that we can use anywhere to improve the quality by using different sensors used for tracking and tracing things. IOT with food supply chain (FSC) would elevate food standards. This paper explores more about IOT devices working to secure packet food and frozen food. This paper also discusses future scope about the same model. By this research, technology and information might be valuable for all the consumers to increase awareness in addition to knowledge.

articleTitle: Repgen Security Checking Tool for Startups
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Cyber security is one of the foremost habitually examined themes these days. Your company cannot protect itself from cybercriminals without a cyber security plan. As the number of security-related threats increases, so will the number of security professionals available. Small and medium-sized startups, in general, do not invest in data protection, making it easier for cyber criminals to target them. The report provided by the programmer will give us an idea of how vulnerable the system is to bad guys in society, and if they are critical, we should seek the assistance of security specialists. The goal of this term paper is to develop an instrument that can be used by security personnel who are less skilled or experienced. Cyber security plays a basic parcel with inside the field of data advancement. Securing the data have gotten to be one of the foremost unmistakable challenges interior the show up day. When we think of cyber security, the first thing that springs to mind is ‘internet crimes,’ which are rapidly growing. Various governments and businesses are taking various steps to prepare for these cyber intrusions. Aside from numerous precautions, cyber security is still a huge issue for a lot of people. On a very basic level, this study focuses on the issues that cyber security faces in the initial few steps. It also focuses on the most recent developments in cyber security tactics, ethics, and initiatives to change the state of cyber security.

articleTitle: Social Educational Streaming Platform Using HTML Live Streaming
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The present paper describes the design and architecture streaming technology to stream the educational video so that academics won’t affect. Streaming large internet-based videos requires lots of bandwidth. This paper discusses the idea of streaming large videos over the internet using HLS(HTML LIVE Streaming) technology. It allows lecturer and student to be in sync for a clear understanding and help the student to be more visually understandable than the other way. It also helps improve the overall learning experience. Since this model can be further implemented in other scenarios of two-way communication and being synced up without the boundaries.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Forecasting Techniques for the Covid-19 pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The burial of bodies became a trend in the cause of ongoing pending (Novel Coronavirus), more than50 a million people all over the globe are adversely affected, hence the analysis and forecasting techniques are necessary to regain the human livelihood. The enlargement of technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, are en route into all the living aspects. Hence by using AI, ML, DL, Advanced technologies and existing models ARIMA, PROPHET, SVM, RNN, Faster & Mask R-CNN, RESNET-50, and other techniques such as logarithmic scaling and exponential smoothing so on, the spread of VIRUS, the effect of countries economic growth, confirmed cases, fatality rate, recoveries are predicted to overcome the life threat due to SARS. Such that different predictive techniques are used to forecast. The advancement in the past algorithms to acquire accurate results are been introduced and described.

articleTitle: Realization of Chua’s circuit using VDBA based nonlinear resistor and inductor simulator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: A Voltage Differencing Buffered Amplifier (VDBA) based autonomous Chua’s chaotic circuit is suggested in this work. An active circuit topology for non-linear resistor is proposed which is a constituent of Chua’s circuit. It employs two VDBAs and two resistors to provide desired breakpoints. Also, the area consuming passive inductor has been implemented using VDBA, which in turn has been designed using macromodel of Current Feedback Operational Amplifier (CFOA), to provide a different alternative to the VLSI based integration problem of the chaotic circuits. A comparison with the existing designs shows a significant reduction in area in terms of passive components with the suggested design. The operation of the proposed Chua’s circuit is shown with LTspice design environment and the simulations obtained are in fair inclination with its theory.

articleTitle: Flashover performance of an AC insulator under various uniform and FSNU contamination conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Contamination, bright (UV) radiation, and electro-warm pressure put various sorts of protectors in risky circumstances. Contamination collects on encasing in an assortment of structures, including uniform, non-uniform, and lopsided. The discoveries of uniform and fan-molded non-uniform (FSNU) contamination tests under AC voltage on four unique sorts of unadulterated and endured encasings are accounted for in this review. The strong layer method is utilized to settle toxins on the cover surface. The outcomes show that when contamination non-consistency degree (J) develops from 1 to 16, the flashover voltage of both unadulterated and matured examples diminishes. Contamination tests from a few modern districts were acquired and placed on the protectors. The flashover voltage of unadulterated and matured examples decreases and the contamination non-consistency degree (J) ascends while estimating the presentation of FSNU grimy covers in shifted extents. Covers examined were matured for as long as about a month (672h). Even though there was no way to see an impact of multi-week (168h) sped up maturing on flashover voltage and morphology of protectors, the flashover strength of the examples is decreased as the maturing time frame protracts. Because of the new protectors, a measurable report was performed to decide the flashover voltage of sped-up matured separators under uniform and FSNU pollution. The study’s purpose was to identify insulators that could withstand industrial, sunny and windy conditions.

articleTitle: Designing of PI and Smith Predictor Controller for the Dynamic Performance Enhancement of Non-linear PEM Fuel Cell System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The PEM Fuel Cell technology is very efficient and clean, and it is often regarded as the brightest source of green energy. The working principles of a PEMFC system are complicated nonlinear systems. The manifold pressure at cathode side should be maintained to avoid the oxygen starvation. In this paper, P-I and Smith-Predictor Controllers are proposed for the controlling manifold pressure of a nonlinear PEM fuel cell. The result of nonlinear PEM-FC with P-I and Smith Predictor Controller are collated in terms of settling time, over-shoot, steady state error and rise time. The proposed controllers are optimized with PID Tuner. The results of MATLAB simulation reveal that the Smith Predictor Controller outperforms the P-I Controller in nonlinear PEM-FC systems.

articleTitle: Arduino-based fault distance locator for subterranean cable detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: There has been a rising demand for subterranean deployments because of security and infrastructural growth in the densely populated urban and suburban districts, as well as the need to retain aesthetic qualities in many modern communities. In subterranean cabling systems there are no typical failures of the overhead transmission lines, although some errors, such as short circuits and open circuit failures, are connected with these systems. It is highly cumbersome, costly and time consuming to locate any such failure precisely because its power distribution system is concealed. As a result, an Arduino-powered microcontroller-based underground cable fault distance locator is intended to identify and pinpoint the position of faults in underground cable lines. Underground cable systems are a typical practise in big metropolitan areas. In this project, the ideas of Ohm’s law are applied and are put underground with a short circuit type fault situation. The tracer method is used to discover faults and to construct a prototype of an underground cable fault distance finder.

articleTitle: Reduction of Cryptography Processing Upward in BGP Security Protocols: An Investigation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In computer networks, an autonomous system consists of a number of routes by which the packet can be transmitted from sender to receiver, and this routing protocol helps the sender to determine the specific path to be used for the transmission of packet. Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is among one of these routing protocols. Both research and standardization are investing amounts to make BGP safer and reliable. Therefore, to enforce security many cryptographic (encryption, decryption, key-based, etc.) techniques have been implied in BGP. This paper provides a literature review about the Security in Border Gateway Protocol and the cryptographic processing mechanisms used in securing Border Gateway Protocol for minimizing CPU workload/overhead.

articleTitle: The Software Component Reusability: An Efficient Strategy to Develop an Enhanced Software through Using Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In the years hate, aspects of reusability software are very strange and cannot be avoided by building new software arms. Service-oriented architecture (SOA) is a model for organising and leveraging distributed capabilities that may be controlled by several domains. This is a type of software design in which application components use network communication protocols to provide services to other components. In software components, the reusable handling project team is generally very familiar with the use of the source code database, so they can find the code they need and easily enter it into the application. Developers can also apply code to the repository for analysis, approval and inclusion. Developers can also monitor which applications using the UX version received. This is allowed because the library section is permitted. The software development process includes development time, development costs and human power requirements and so on. To reduce these things, programmers can apply technology called Reusability software components. The process of implementing or modifying software systems using existing software components is known as software component use. which can reduce human power, costs, and time. In this paper applying a new framework for SOA architecture in this architecture ensures the reuse of user services, easy maintenance to software, independent platforms, reliability, and scalability. In this framework for reuse and reduce the time and cost of software components to develop enhanced projects in an efficient way.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Islanding Detection Method for Grid-Tied Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic is one of the most emerging and greener renewable sources of electric power. Integrating a PV system into a power grid system poses certain issues in terms of utility power grid stability and power quality. The main problem is the phenomenon of islanding. Therefore, Anti-islanding protection is an essential feature of every grid-connected solar photovoltaic system during the islanding operation mode. In the paper implementation and analysis of anti-islanding protection for grid connected solar photovoltaic system. The proposed ROCPAD relay has been tested on microgrid architectures with various operational parameter variations, and the findings show that it can consistently identify islanding conditions in microgrids.

articleTitle: Classification of CT Scan Images for diagnosis of Covid-19 using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Coronavirus diseases is a contagious transmissible infectious malady rooted by the SARS-CoV-2 virus and it mostly affects the lungs thereby causing a global health care problem. Coronavirus triggers respiratory tract infection by infecting upper respiratory tract consisting of sinuses, nose, and throat or lower tract of respiratory system that includes windpipe and lungs. WHO proclaimed the COVID-19 outbreak a global epidemic. To control the spreading of novel Coronavirus, early detection and cure is mandatory. Although RT-PCR test is used to detect the infected humans but owing to colossal demand RT-PCR kits are now limited, and its low reliability made way for implementation of radiographic procedures such as X-Rays and Computed Tomography-Scan for symptomatic purposes. These come with a great specificity for diagnosing and detecting Covid-19 instances. This study suggests adopting a Deep Learning technique to automate the diagnosis of COVID19 infection using CT scans of patients for explicit identification of Covid-19. CNN namely Densenet, Inception and Xception networks or architectures are used in a deep learning architecture to distinguish human beings based on whether confirmed positive or not for COVID-19 infection. These networks are then collated on the ground of their accuracy and the outcomes procured from various CNN models are analysed to obtain a robust system.

articleTitle: Historical Sea Ice Reduction Modelling Using OBCD techniques for the Bering Sea employing LANDSAT 8 Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: This research work presents the effect of global warming on the snow level reduction of the Bering Sea. The Bering Sea, which consists of snow cover throughout the winters, is losing its snow cover very quickly due to global warming. Other object-based change detection (OBCD) techniques are used to analyze the effect of the difference in the snow cover. These techniques are also compared to obtain optimum classification techniques for modeling snow cover. These techniques are compared with each other for the same geographical conditions. The Mahalanobis distance classification algorithm has provided the best classification result for the pre-image, whereas the minimum distance classification algorithm has obtained the best classification results for the post image.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Techniques to Advanced Signals and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Among the optical neural networks, the dynamicity, complexity, bear dramatically improved payable according to the wideness over superior luminous techniques, and the optical cross-connect technologies then diverse community infrastructure possess great challenges into the optical network management then preservation because of the community operators. The article established a time-domain-based artificial intelligence radar provision because of gesture consciousness utilizing a 33 GS/s direct copy approach. For each static yet strong gesture, a 1-D convolutional neural community is used, with consciousness costs of 93.2 percent and 90.5 percent achieved. The radar rule is shaped including an a65-nm CMOS method so much consumes 95mW concerning power.

articleTitle: Operation of Inductively Coupled DSTATCOM for Power Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The shrinkage of power quality (PQ) was recognized as a perilous failure mode encountered in direct coupled distributed static compensator (DSTATCOM). To recover the PQ, coupling transformer is served in conjunction with DSTATCOM in this research article. The system equivalent circuit of inductively coupled DSTATCOM is achieved by considering impedance of both transformer and DSTATCOM to reveal the filtering mechanism. A case study is inspected in detail to illustrate the performance of both self-supported capacitor and split capacitor interfaced inductively coupled DSTATCOM. The self-supported capacitor based inductively coupled DSTATCOM is augmented better as compared to other in terms of harmonics curtailment, improvement in power factor and potential regulation etc. Finally, MATLAB simulation results using i cos $\theta$ control strategy for unbalanced loading condition is adjudged to showcase the suitable topology as required for the public network by satisfying IEEE-519-2017 standard.

articleTitle: Adaptive Directional Lifting Transform based Optimization to Extreme Visual Recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Rank minimization is giving the solutions to the problems in image denoising, machine learning, computer vision and compressed sensing applications. The corrupted image will not convey the original information and during transmission the information may further tampered. The image is corrupted with small amount of noise, it may be recovered with the conventional methods. The amount of noise in the image is more, the existing methods are unable to recover the corrupted image. Here an Adaptive Directional Lifting Wavelet Transform (ADLWT) is used along with the familiar Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers optimization method. The proposed method is able to recover the corrupted image that contains high percentage of missing observations. The objective of the work is to provide an efficient method to recover the damaged pixels in the image and to provide the optimal λ value which can recover with high accuracy and efficiency with respect to quality metrics. The proposed method is evaluated with the familiar assessment measures like Mean Square Error (MSE), Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity (SSIM). The recorded values are better when compared with the existing methods.

Author Keywords: ADLWT based direction method of multipliers

articleTitle: Identifying the Key Features of the Object
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The applications of computer vision are boundless, both in usage and technical impressiveness. Real-time object dimensions detection is an essential issue from many areas of industry. Detecting objects key features like size, shape and color of an object in an image is a perplexing task and has numerous real-world applications. The major challenges faced with object size measurement were precise withdrawal of object borderline and scale deviation in object size due to its deepness in the apprehended image. In this research, we proposed a system that detects the key features of an object like size shape and color. The preferred algorithm is computer vision and it includes basic tools that are efficient enough to find the key features of an object. Various global properties of an object, such as shape and colour, characterize the entity on the whole. The proposed system extracts the objects from the image by performing segmentation and removes the noise at the background by using canny’s edge detector we obtain all the contours which helps to identify the edges of the object. In addition to this we have used mask-RCNN to perform object segmentation in case of overlapped objects.To determine the distance between, we must compute the Euclidian Distance between the object’s edges.

articleTitle: IoT based System Design for Human Health Monitoring for Covid -19 Outbreak
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: A prescription for AI can assist physicians in developing more precise diagnoses and enhancing patient outcomes. Physicians now have a formidable new ally in the war on disease. This article discusses the importance of IoT-based health monitoring systems and the major characteristics that differentiate them from traditional health monitoring systems and also how the system is helpful in times of pandemic. The proposed system will help the physicians in tracking fundamental patient data, as well as those who live in remote places. The proposed model has been successfully emulated on software through the use of ThinkSpeak and Proteus. The hardware implementation is discussed utilizing a microcontroller, sensors, and an ESP8266 Wi-Fi module to create an IOT-based health monitoring system capable of successfully displaying basic patient parameters.

articleTitle: Analyze Performance and Market Share of Various Cryptocurrencies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Bitcoin is the popular forms of digital currencies that is rapidly gaining ground and trending widely. Bitcoin has introduced an influx of cryptocurrencies. It is a cryptocurrency based on a decentralized shared system. It’s gotten the true standard for cryptocurrencies, moving an ever-developing army of devotees and side projects. This paper attempts to respond to your inquiries concerning digital currency. In this paper, we study and analyze the various Cryptocurrencies by comparing them on the basis of market cap, mining technique, mining algorithm, use, and transaction settlement time of each mining technique. Specially we focus on how does Cryptocurrency mine? And depicted a comparative study of various cryptocurrencies’ performance in terms of settling time and market cap.

articleTitle: Analysis of the IoT Framework for Sensor Data Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In this paper, major building blocks of IOTized ecosystem is discussed. The ecosystem is further divided into sub-ecosystem as IOT apps ranging from smart home, smart healthcare, smart transportation, smart retailer, agriculture and smart education system. This includes diversely connected devices which continuously communicate with each other and perform status update on localized and remote system. Further use cases have been developed and their framework have been proposed and compared to cater the requirements of the IOT ecosystem.

articleTitle: Piezoelectricity Operated Automatic Door for Covid Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic also known as the Corona Virus worldwide epidemic is contemplate as the transcendent critical global health disaster in the world. Pneumonia, acute respiratory syndrome, and even death are the severity of this virus. We are living in a situation where Covid infection cases can be increased unexpectedly anytime if we do not follow the advisory of World Health organization (WHO). The majority of people who are infected with the virus has experienced mild to moderate fever. This virus spread rapidly in public places such as hospitals, metro station, railway station, malls etc. In such crowded areas, the chances of virus spread is high and we can prevent this by social distancing and measuring the temperature of the every individual without using human interference. In our idea we have introduced a fully automatic temperature detection system which would energized by piezoelectric generator. We have also implemented an automatic door opening system in which the door of a particular place will remain closed if temperature is above the preset value. The opening and closing of door is done through the piezoelectric generated power.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis, Design and simulation of Piezoresistive Pressure Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In this paper, we created a Piezo-resistive Pressure Sensor based on MEMS technology to apply pressure to the sensor’s edge and studied the model’s pressure effects. The boundary currents, Piezo-resistance, and final structural equations at the domain level are all described in this model, which use structural equations to solve the final electrical equations on a thin layer that coincides with a boundary within the model’s geometry. When a pressure of l00kPa is applied on the substrate, a maximum displacement of $7 \times 10-30$ $\mu m$ is measured.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Classification of X-RAY of the Diagnosis of Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: Coronavirus, also known as covid-19, was a newly found disease in 2019. It is a highly transmissible virus that has a noxious effect on people all over the world. The most familiar indication of covid-19 are wheezing, cold and raised body temperature. Doctors and medical field experts need to assess at topmost priority a patient with symptoms relating to COVID-19. The most Critical task is to diagnose it with low resource settings. To help in detection of COVID-19, we propose the extraction of features from Chest X-ray images, a technology available at most hospitals and classifying them using machine learning. We compiled 3-class dataset of X-ray chest images including COVID-19, Viral pneumonia, normal cases. We labeled datasets then using Vertex AI and Vision AI trained the model. It automatically uses 80% of the dataset for training, 10% for corroborating and 10% for testing whereas Vision AI process the images for training.

articleTitle: Multiband Slotted Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna with Enhanced Bandwidth for Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Mobile and Embedded Technology Conference (MECON)
abstract: In this paper, a circular shaped microstrip patch antenna with four slots on patch has been designed with Lshape and simulated on CST software. Simulated a microstrip antenna with FR4 substrate and thickness of 1.6 mm and a relative permittivity of $\varepsilon \mathrm{r}=4.3$ is used. In this structure microstrip antenna is resonant at three different frequencies 6. 3GHz, 7.4GHz and 9. 3GHz with return losses of -38.48, 33.19 and -37.88 with the band width of 590MHz(6.12 GHz to 6.71GHz), 750MHz(7.08GHz to 7. 83GHz) and 1. 27GHz (8. 68GHz to 9. 95GHz) respectively. The proposed antenna shows good performance across all three covered bands for Satellite Applications, Synchronous Transport Modulelevel1-SMTI and X-band applications.

articleTitle: A Comparison between Shortest Path Algorithms Using Runtime Analysis and Negative Edges in Computer Networks

articleTitle: Consumer Rating Analysis and Recommendation Methodology Using Machine Learning
